name: Dasamoolahareethaki

sections.overview: Dasamoolahareethaki – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.reference_ashtanga_hridaya_chikitsa_stha:
What is Dasamoolahareethaki? 
 Dasamoolahareethaki is a very effective ayurvedic formulation that is prepared from very effective mixture of herbs. The main ingredients of this formulation are haritaki and dashamoola’s decoction. It is in a form of herbal jam or paste. 
 What are the Ingredients? 

 Haritaki – Terminalia chebula 
 Dashamoola Kashaya 
 Elaiachi – Elettaria cardamomum 
 Dalchini – Cinnamomum verum 
 Patra – Cinnamomum tamala 
 Trikatu – Pepper, Long pepper and ginger 
 Yavakshara 
 Honey 
 Jaggery 

 Method of Preparation of Dasamoolahareethaki 

 Take all ingredients of pharmacopoeial quality. 
 Take 3.07 liters of dhasmoola kashaya and mix with 300 grams of haritaki. 
 Add above ingredients with 4.8 kg jaggery and heat the mixture to get the semi-solid consistency. 
 After above process, add the mixture with ingredients elaichi, dalchini, patra, trikatu, yavakshara and honey. Take yavakshara up to 12 grams, honey up to 384 grams and other herbs up to 48 grams. 
 After this step, the formulation is ready. 
 On cooling to room temperature add powders of ingredients numbered 4 to 6, followed by honey and mix well to obtain a homogenous mixture. 
 Pack it in tightly closed containers to protect from light and moisture. 

 How Dashamoola does looks like? 
 Brown semi solid, sticky paste, with spicy odor and sweet, pungent taste. 
 Where and how to store it? 
 Store in a cool place in tightly closed amber colored containers, to protect from light and moisture.
sections.dose_to_be_given_as_per_age:
5 to 10 grams, one to two times a day, before or after meals, with milk or water. 
 Dose for children below 5 years -1-2 grams, once or twice a day with honey, warm water / milk. 
 Dosage for children between 5 – 12 years of age – 5 grams once or twice a day along with a teaspoon of honey or warm water / milk. 
 There are no side effects but stomach can be upset due to over dose.
sections.indications_of_dasamoolahareethaki:
Inflammatory problems 
 Fever 
 Bleeding disorders 
 Abdominal lump 
 Abdominal disorder due to slow digestion or accumulated toxins 
 Tastelessness 
 Disease of spleen 
 Abnormality of semen 
 Difficult breathing, Asthma 
 Urinary infections 
 Liver ailments 
 Anemia 
 Rheumatoid arthritis 
 Bowel problems 

 Medicinal Properties of Dasamoolahareethaki 

 Anti-Oxidant (Free Radical Scavenging) 
 Anti-Inflammatory (Reduces Swelling) 
 Antipyretic (Fever Reducing) 
 Analgesic (Pain Relieving)
sections.health_benefits_of_dasamoolahareethaki:
Especially useful in diseases that occur due to vitiation of Vata and Kapha. 
 Fever, sannipat jwar, fever after delivery. 
 Inflammation, dizziness 
 Low appetite 
 Respiratory ailments, cough
sections.contraindications:
Take under medical supervision. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
